column7: azurekms Decrypt keyed the version MAC of a pinned, MAC'd envelope with the Key Vault unwrap result before checking its length, so a short result (0/1/13 bytes) panicked under GODEBUG=fips140=only ("crypto/hmac: use of keys shorter than 112 bits ...") and in default mode surfaced as an integrity-check failure. An unwrap result that is not crypto.KEKSize is now refused before versionMAC with the provider's wrong-length error and wiped, identically in both modes (the test runs in default CI too). Legacy and unpinned blobs are unchanged. Red (GODEBUG=fips140=only) at 5d80e2cfc: Decrypt panicked. FIPS-TAILS-2 item 3.
